spanish: Y entrare el sol, y limpio, y después comerá desde las santidades, porque su pan él.

findings.issue: Qal sequential perfect 3ms ‘be/become clean’ is only the bare adjective limpio, so the 3ms verbal predicate is omitted.
Qal sequential perfect 3ms is rendered with the archaic future subjunctive entrare; the subject remains el sol.
The verbless identification of his bread with the 3ms pronoun is left unpredicated as su pan él.

notes: Sol, después, comerá, desde, las santidades, porque, and él otherwise match the tokens in order.
